title: Dialogues of Dissent: Thematic and Rhetorical Dimensions of Hate and Counter-Hate Speech in Social Media Conversations
reasoning: The paper focuses on introducing and applying an annotation scheme for the rhetorical and thematic analysis of hate speech and counter-speech on social media. While the case study involves religious-based hate speech (antisemitism), the work is centered on linguistics, communication strategies, and social media discourse analysis rather than benchmarking or evaluating religion, ethics, or moral systems.
